findings.sectionRef: Approach > Implementation Strategy (step 5) and Acceptance Criteria > B4
findings.description: The plan referenced `scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs:40-58` as where `runUpdateCrewSession` lives, but did not spec how the proposed `--phase` and `--regression-reason` CLI flags integrate with the function's existing signature. Need to clarify CLI flag parsing, argument forwarding, and which write site stamps regressionReason.
findings.resolution: Manual fix (review-loop.sh fix-engine broken on Windows — codex CLI spawn ENOENT): plan step 5 now spells out (a) `--phase` is parsed into `args.phase` and threaded through `runUpdateCrewSession({ ..., phase })`, merged into the explicit CrewSessionRef before insertion at sync-ralph-state.mjs:84-90; (b) `--regression-reason` is a NEW top-level mode `args.command === 'recordRegression'` (sibling of updateCrewSession / finalizeCrewSession) with handler `runRecordRegression` that sets `state.byTaskId[taskId].regressionReason` and writes the sidecar; (c) AC B4 is split into B4a and B4b matching the two integration points.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect runUpdateCrewSession and the regression-reason write path; spell out exact CLI flag parsing, argument forwarding, and which RalphPipelineState write site stamps regressionReason.

findings.sectionRef: Approach > Implementation Strategy (step 6) and Files to Create/Modify > sync-core.mjs
findings.description: Plan said `scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs` applies the read-side fallback when loading overview-data.js, but did not identify the exact function. sync-core.mjs is 1022 lines; the fallback must be applied at the load/normalize point.
findings.resolution: Manual fix: plan step 6 now names `loadOverviewData(dataFile)` at sync-core.mjs:818-827 as the choke point; specifies that the function delegates to the field-agnostic `parseOverviewData` AST-walker in parse-overview-data.mjs (do NOT modify) and that the normalization (lifecycle/prompts fallback + `mapLegacyPhaseToLifecycle` helper) is applied after parse, before returning `data`. Calls out the 6 downstream consumer sites (lines 103, 294, 317, 518, 547, 933) that all transitively pick up the normalized shape.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the specific loader/normalizer function in sync-core.mjs that reads overview-data.js entries and apply the fallback there.

findings.description: E1 said `grep -c '"phase":' plans/overview-data.js` should return 0 "against the OverviewTask scope" — phrasing was ambiguous since CrewSessionRef.phase is also a JSON key with the same string.
findings.resolution: Manual fix: E1 rewritten to state that overview-data.js is hand-curated and contains only OverviewTask shapes (never CrewSessionRef — those are watcher-derived in plans/overview-ralph-state.json). The grep is now a clean zero check without scope disambiguation. Added an explicit pre-flight scan command (`grep -oE '"phase":\s*"[^"]+"' plans/overview-data.js | sort -u`) to enumerate distinct values for exhaustive mapping.
findings.suggestedFix: Rewrite E1 to be unambiguous: grep returns 0 after rewrite; CrewSessionRef.phase occurrences are in a different sidecar file.

findings.description: Step 6 (sync-core.mjs read fallback) precedes steps 7-10 (viewer + tests), but the dependency relationship was not called out. Parallel impl members could run step 7 before step 6.
findings.resolution: Manual fix: Implementation Strategy now opens with an explicit Ordering Constraint paragraph stating that steps 1-2 (types + schema) MUST land before any other step starts; step 6 (sync-core.mjs loadOverviewData fallback) MUST land before steps 7-10 finalize; steps 6-10 are sequenced inside a single impl member. The sync-and-viewer cluster rationale in suggested-decomposition.json is updated to mirror the constraint and explicitly forbid cross-member parallelism.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an explicit ordering note in the Implementation Strategy section and mirror in suggested-decomposition.json.

findings.sectionRef: Acceptance Criteria > C2 and Open Questions item 3
findings.description: AC C2 should explicitly enumerate the required PHASE_TO_BADGE_TEXT keys so the impl member doesn't drop the legacy ones thinking they're dead code.
findings.resolution: Manual fix: AC C2 now enumerates the required keys (`tracked`, `merged`, `archived` plus legacy `plan-ready`, `shipped`, `closed` plus any additional legacy values discovered during the AC E1 exhaustive scan); states the v2.3.0 retention rationale and v2.4.0 removal timing explicitly.

findings.description: The plan referenced `parallel-ready-tasks.ts:93-98` for the deriveNextCommand call site, but did not state the exact current call shape vs. expected post-change shape.
findings.resolution: Manual fix: US-006 now confirms that `parallel-ready-tasks.ts:93-98` already calls `deriveNextCommand(task.ralph, task)` — the second `task` argument was reserved for the seed-prompt fallback per the existing inline comment, so no signature change at the call site is required. Only the runtime behavior inside deriveNextCommand changes (Change C path).
findings.suggestedFix: Specify in US-006 the exact current and expected call shape.
